text: ATERNUM, s town of Lucerna in Italy, now _Alteris_, (Chorusas )). Alfo a town in the territory of the Piceni, now _Pofcara_, a port-town of Naples, fitu-ated and the infinite. E. Long 15.25. V.Lav. 42.50.

parsed.faithful: ATERNUM, a town of Lucania in Italy, now Alerni, (Cluvenus). Also a town in the territory of the Piceni, now Pescara, a port-town of Naples, situated on the Adriatic. E. Long. 15. 25. N. Lat. 42. 30.
